chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: "Run Joe" Taylor and "The Great Pretender"
summary: McRae names co-writers and recalls that Taylor sold "The Great Pretender" for fifty dollars before it became the Platters' hit.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
